page.overview:
Who is Berndt Aberwold?

A wizard lord from the mysterious Amber College of Magic, Berndt Aberwold lived somewhere in the wilds outside Nuln, but regularly visited the city. He was an honoured member of Grand Marshal Erkstein's war cabinet, and had campaigned with the old commander in the days of their youth. Although he was discouraged from doing so in the city, Berndt rode a two-headed griffon named Quickclaw.
